**Concept Used:**

Arithmetic Mean = ∑(fᵢ xᵢ )/n

**Calculations:**

Arithmetic mean = (0times 3+1times 2+ 2 times 2+3times 4+ 4 times 6+ 5times 7+ 6times 7+ 7×5+8times 3+ 9times 4+ 10times 2)/(3+2+2+4+6+7+7+5+3+4+2)

Arithmetic mean = (234)/(45)=5.2

**∴ The arithmetic mean of the given data is 5.2**
